digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verified CI/CD workflow (Ubuntu and macOS test pipeline)
propositions: Ubuntu default-tier pytest cells occupy 1,812 runner-seconds (30.2 runner-minutes) per Verified run; root causes are redundant YAML parsing in bridge-cadence test (342.22s per run via 1,440 repeated _bridge_schedule() calls), unnecessary subprocess invocations in render_unit existential assertion (232→1), redundant legacy Pandoc conversions in hardening oracle (883 duplicate subprocess calls), AST provenance fixture setup traversals (9.54M ast.walk iterations per run), and static policy re-execution across four matrix cells (52-55s duplicated).

Moving full real-Pandoc corpus replay (884 units over multiple passes) to a dedicated weekly/manual external-integration workflow, while retaining a small representative live-Pandoc contract in Verify per platform and proposing static golden expected outputs with version-drift assertion, preserves all existing assertion classes (cardinality, protected excerpts, binary provenance, deterministic settling) without reducing coverage and aligns with Pandoc, nbconvert, pypandoc, Kubernetes, and Rust upstream practice.

Same-change workflow-concurrency blocking caused 24–25 minute pre-job waits in runs 31834896849 and 31841305299; root cause is job-level always() predicates in gerrit-verify.yaml preventing cancellation of superseded runs, resolved by change 1792 (cancellation-aware status check replacement).

Current remaining macOS completion-path bottleneck is execution variance of 21m12s–28m09s in default tier and recurring 35.0–35.1s socket.getfqdn call in test_server_binds_loopback_only setup; no individual Ubuntu test phase exceeds 30s post-Pandoc-corpus move.

Jira DC integration is already correctly routed: tests/external/live_jira_dc is deselected from Verify (-m "not integration and not external"), runs 62 tests in dedicated weekly/manual external harness at 2,384–2,635s, and saving zero runner-minutes from hot-path removal.

Shared session-level fixtures for git-store construction and AST provenance indexing are accepted prior art (peculiar-calmy-bubblefish template-copy and analogical-dashing-fennecfox caching); next module-level optimization seam identified in test_secret_screen_e7a9.py (28.998s aggregate), test_list_filters.py (25.856s), and test_b636_rebuild_history_loss.py (19.230s) repeated fixture totals.
